name: isDataLockComplianceModeEnabled
definition: At least one backup target locks data in compliance mode: a retention that no user or key can shorten or remove.
population: the backup storage targets the integration lists, with their lock mode
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A target listing in which at least one target's default retention mode is compliance.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms. Other backup integrations already emit this key; their meaning is not yet validated against this entry.

notes: Backblaze B2: fileLockConfiguration.value.defaultRetention.mode == compliance. Governance mode does not count; a key with bypassGovernance can override it.
